close_reason: Stale: code uses a plain const &[&str] linear scan with no HashSet pre-check. The described two-step HashSet+linear-scan issue does not exist. Existing doc comment at helpers.rs:83 already explains the linear scan choice.
description:
File: /home/mark/PROJECT/JMAP/crate-jmap-mail-server/src/helpers.rs:66-72
Issue: After a successful O(1) HashSet lookup (line 66), the function discards the result and immediately does a second O(n) linear scan through IMMUTABLE_EMAIL_FIELDS (lines 69-72) to retrieve the same &'static str. The HashSet already confirmed membership; storing &'static str values in the set (HashSet<&'static str>) allows set.get(key.as_str()).copied() to return the canonical pointer directly, eliminating the redundant scan.
Fix: Change IMMUTABLE_SET to HashSet<&'static str> and replace the find() call with set.get(key.as_str()).copied() to collapse the two-step lookup into one.
title: find_immutable_patch_key redundant linear scan after HashSet hit
